about_the_game:
Step into the heart of New York — a city ruled by chaos, crime, and ambition. In this top-down open-world action game inspired by the classics, you’ll rise from a street nobody to a powerful underworld figure. Every block, every gang, and every decision shapes your path to dominance.

Explore the city’s gritty neighborhoods, from neon-lit streets to dark industrial docks. Take on dangerous missions for rival gangs, smuggle goods, steal cars, and fight for respect. Or build your own crew and start a criminal empire that will make your name feared across the city.

The world around you is alive and reactive — cops respond to your crimes, gangs remember your choices, and your reputation opens or closes doors. Align yourself with the Italian Mafia, the Russian Mob, the Triads, or the Latino Cartel — or betray them all to rule alone.

Drive through the city’s iconic districts, engage in intense shootouts, and discover a deep story woven through loyalty, betrayal, and survival. Every mission brings you closer to power — but in New York, every ally can become an enemy.

Whether you prefer brutal street action or strategic domination, the fate of the city is in your hands.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

short_description: Step into the gritty underworld of New York. Build your reputation from the ground up — fight, steal, and rise through the ranks of dangerous gangs or form your own crew. Every action shapes your fate in a living, reactive city full of chaos and crime.
